study_meta.population_raw: 9120 confirmed COVID-19 cases reported by 27 provincial and 264 urban health commissions
study_meta.sample_size_raw: 1407 transmission pairs (662 household, 745 nonhousehold) forming 643 transmission clusters
study_meta.method_raw: Reconstruction of transmission pairs from publicly reported case data; serial interval computed as days between symptom onset of primary and secondary cases; normal distribution fitted via MCMC with Gibbs sampling and noninformative flat prior (100000 iterations, burn-in 40000, thinning interval 10)
